title: Distill to Think, Foresee to Act: Cognitive-Physical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2605.21139v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current end-to-end autonomous driving models are fundamentally constrained by the behavioral cloning ceiling of imitation learning. While reinforcement learning offers a path to smarter autonomy, it demands two missing pieces of infrastructure: (1) a cognitive foundation that understands traffic semantics and driving intent, and (2) a foresighted physical environment that can anticipate the consequences of candidate actions. To this end, we propose CoPhy, a CognitivePhysical reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving. To distill to think, we distill VLM knowledge into the BEV encoder and then discard the VLM entirely, retaining cognitive ability at zero inference cost while releasing the cognitive channel as a pluggable interface for optional human language commands. translated_title: 蒸馏以思考，预见以行动：面向自动驾驶的认知-物理强化学习
translated_abstract: 当前的端到端自动驾驶模型从根本上受限于模仿学习的行为克隆上限。虽然强化学习为实现更智能的自主性提供了一条路径，但它需要两个尚缺失的基础设施：(1) 一个能够理解交通语义和驾驶意图的认知基础；(2) 一个能够预判候选动作后果的具有前瞻性的物理环境。为此，我们提出了 CoPhy，一个面向自动驾驶的认知-物理强化学习框架。为了“蒸馏以思考”，我们将视觉语言模型（VLM）的知识蒸馏到 BEV 编码器中，然后完全舍弃 VLM，在零推理成本下保留认知能力，同时将认知通道释放为可插拔接口，以支持可选的人类自然语言指令。为了“预见以行动”，我们构建了一个自回归的 BEV 世界模型，该模型以候选动作为条件显式预测未来的语义地图，为……
tldr: CoPhy 框架通过将视觉语言模型知识蒸馏进 BEV 编码器实现零推理成本的认知能力，并构建自回归 BEV 世界模型来预测候选动作的未来后果，从而突破模仿学习的行为克隆上限，实现自动驾驶的认知-物理强化学习。
en_tdlr: CoPhy distills VLM knowledge into a BEV encoder to retain cognitive ability at zero inference cost, and builds an auto-regressive BEV world model that foresees the consequences of candidate actions, breaking the imitation-learning ceiling for autonomous driving via cognitive-physical reinforcement learning.
